value.rationale: The defining paper itself uses shortest-word multiplicity to distinguish small critical automata, and six states are the endpoint of its exhaustive unrestricted-alphabet census, so the parameter is not an arbitrary slice. The exact marginals expose structure invisible from reset length: every optimal word ignores one available input, all reset to one state, and the remaining letter counts factor into low-degree polynomial powers. These data form a compact benchmark for optimal-reset-language algorithms and structural study of slowly synchronizing automata.
